properties.statement: A function table loads iff axis names and outputs are unique, interpolation matches the axis count, every axis is NaN-free, strictly increasing with ≥ 2 values, data has the implied nesting and no NaN leaf (Q-9), and any shape assertion equals the implied shape.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable), Esm.Closed.Tables.validateTable T = Except.ok () ↔ Esm.Closed.Tables.TableValid T

properties.statement: Every rejection of a table names a violated condition with its §9.5.5 code.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable) (c : Esm.Closed.Code), Esm.Closed.Tables.validateTable T = Except.error c → c = "table_axis_duplicate_name" ∧ ¬(List.map (fun (x : Esm.Closed.Tables.Axis) => x.name) T.axes).Nodup ∨ (c = "table_outputs_duplicate_name" ∧ ∃ (os : List String), T.outputs = Option.some os ∧ ¬os.Nodup) ∨ c = "table_interpolation_axes_mismatch" ∧ Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable.arityOk T.interpolation T.axes.length = Bool.false ∨ (c = "table_axis_nan" ∧ ∃ a ∈ T.axes, ∃ x ∈ a.values, x.isNaN = Bool.true) ∨ (c = "table_axis_non_monotonic" ∧ ∃ a ∈ T.axes, ∃ (r : List ℝ), a.values = List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r ∧ ¬List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) r) ∨ (c = "unspecified:table_axis_too_short" ∧ ∃ a ∈ T.axes, a.values.length < (2 : ℕ)) ∨ (c = "table_outputs_length_mismatch" ∧ ∃ (os : List String) (xs : List Esm.Closed.Tables.Nested), T.outputs = Option.some os ∧ T.data = Esm.Closed.Tables.Nested.node xs ∧ xs.length ≠ os.length) ∨ c = "table_data_shape_mismatch" ∧ (T.data.hasShape T.expectedShape = Bool.false ∨ ∃ (sh : List ℕ), T.shape = Option.some sh ∧ sh ≠ T.expectedShape) ∨ c = "table_data_nan" ∧ T.data.anyNaN = Bool.true

properties.statement: Q-4: once the name and arity checks pass, a NaN in any axis is table_axis_nan (before table_axis_non_monotonic).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable), (List.map (fun (x : Esm.Closed.Tables.Axis) => x.name) T.axes).Nodup → (∀ (os : List String), T.outputs = Option.some os → os.Nodup) → Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable.arityOk T.interpolation T.axes.length = Bool.true → (∃ a ∈ T.axes, ∃ x ∈ a.values, x.isNaN = Bool.true) → Esm.Closed.Tables.validateTable T = Except.error "table_axis_nan"

properties.statement: Q-11: a table_lookup with non-empty args is table_lookup_args_nonempty.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (tables : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable)) (env : String → Esm.Closed.Num) (tid : String) (axes : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr)) (out : Option Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel) (args : List Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr), args ≠ [] → Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env (Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.lookup tid axes out args) = Except.error "table_lookup_args_nonempty"

properties.statement: A reference to an undeclared table is table_lookup_unknown_table.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (tables : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable)) (env : String → Esm.Closed.Num) (tid : String) (axes : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr)) (out : Option Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel), List.lookup tid tables = Option.none → Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env (Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.lookup tid axes out []) = Except.error "table_lookup_unknown_table"

properties.statement: On a valid table, axis keys that are not exactly its axis names are table_lookup_axis_name_mismatch.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (tables : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable)) (env : String → Esm.Closed.Num) (tid : String) (axes : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr)) (out : Option Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel) (T : Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable), List.lookup tid tables = Option.some T → Esm.Closed.Tables.validateTable T = Except.ok () → (¬∀ (k : String), k ∈ List.map Prod.fst axes ↔ k ∈ List.map (fun (x : Esm.Closed.Tables.Axis) => x.name) T.axes) → Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env (Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.lookup tid axes out []) = Except.error "table_lookup_axis_name_mismatch"

properties.statement: Q-12: an omitted output is output 0, with or without outputs.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable), Esm.Closed.Tables.resolveOutput T Option.none = Esm.Closed.Tables.resolveOutput T (Option.some (Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel.idx (0 : ℕ)))

properties.statement: Q-10: without outputs, the only valid output is 0; a string output is out of range.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable), T.outputs = Option.none → ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : String), (Esm.Closed.Tables.resolveOutput T (Option.some (Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel.idx n)) = if n = (0 : ℕ) then Except.ok (0 : ℕ) else Except.error "table_lookup_output_out_of_range") ∧ Esm.Closed.Tables.resolveOutput T (Option.some (Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel.name s)) = Except.error "table_lookup_output_out_of_range"

properties.statement: With outputs, an integer must be < len(outputs) and a string must be one of them (its first position); otherwise table_lookup_output_out_of_range.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable) (os : List String), T.outputs = Option.some os → ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : String), (Esm.Closed.Tables.resolveOutput T (Option.some (Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel.idx n)) = if n < os.length then Except.ok n else Except.error "table_lookup_output_out_of_range") ∧ (s ∉ os → Esm.Closed.Tables.resolveOutput T (Option.some (Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel.name s)) = Except.error "table_lookup_output_out_of_range") ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < os.length), os[i] = s → (∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < i), os[j] ≠ s) → Esm.Closed.Tables.resolveOutput T (Option.some (Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel.name s)) = Except.ok i

properties.statement: For out_of_bounds clamp, evaluating the §9.5.3 lowered tree equals evaluating the table_lookup, for linear, bilinear and nearest (Q-10 slice, Q-13 nearest), whenever the lookup lowers and its inputs are scalars.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (tables : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable)) (env : String → Esm.Closed.Num) (tid : String) (axes : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr)) (out : Option Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel) (args : List Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr) (e : Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr), Esm.Closed.Tables.lower tables tid axes out args = Except.ok e → (∀ p ∈ axes, ∃ (v : Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env p.2 = Except.ok (Esm.Closed.Tables.Val.num v)) → (∀ (T : Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable), List.lookup tid tables = Option.some T → T.outOfBounds = Esm.Closed.Tables.OOB.clamp) → Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env e = Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env (Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.lookup tid axes out args)

properties.statement: out_of_bounds error: the lookup raises table_lookup_out_of_bounds exactly when an input is strictly outside its axis, otherwise equals the lowered tree.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (tables : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable)) (env : String → Esm.Closed.Num) (tid : String) (axes : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr)) (out : Option Esm.Closed.Tables.OutSel) (args : List Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr) (e : Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr), Esm.Closed.Tables.lower tables tid axes out args = Except.ok e → (∀ p ∈ axes, ∃ (v : Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env p.2 = Except.ok (Esm.Closed.Tables.Val.num v)) → ∃ (T : Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable) (xs : List Esm.Closed.Num), List.lookup tid tables = Option.some T ∧ List.mapM (fun (a : Esm.Closed.Tables.Axis) => (Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env ((List.lookup a.name axes).getD (Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.lit Esm.Closed.Num.nan))).bind Esm.Closed.Tables.Val.asNum) T.axes = Except.ok xs ∧ Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env (Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.lookup tid axes out args) = if (Decidable.decide (T.outOfBounds = Esm.Closed.Tables.OOB.error) && Esm.Closed.Tables.anyOutside T xs) = Bool.true then Except.error Esm.Closed.Tables.Codes.lookupOutOfBounds else Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env e

properties.statement: 'Outside' is strictly below the first knot or strictly above the last (end knots are in range).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (r : List ℝ), (1 : ℕ) ≤ r.length → ∀ (x : ℝ), Esm.Closed.Tables.outside (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) = Bool.true ↔ x < r.getD (0 : ℕ) (0 : ℝ) ∨ r.getD (r.length - (1 : ℕ)) (0 : ℝ) < x

properties.statement: A NaN query is not out of bounds.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (ax : List Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.Tables.outside ax Esm.Closed.Num.nan = Bool.false

properties.statement: The model's nearest lowering index(data, searchsorted(x, midpoints(axis))) evaluates to the nearest semantics.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (tables : List (String × Esm.Closed.Tables.FTable)) (env : String → Esm.Closed.Num) (v : List Esm.Closed.Num) (r0 : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) r0 → (2 : ℕ) ≤ r0.length → v.length = r0.length → ∀ (xe : Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr) (x0 : Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env xe = Except.ok (Esm.Closed.Tables.Val.num x0) → Esm.Closed.Tables.eval tables env (Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.index [Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.const (Esm.Closed.Tables.ofVec v), Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.fn "interp.searchsorted" [xe, Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.const (Esm.Closed.Tables.ofVec (Esm.Closed.Tables.mids (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r0)))]]) = Except.ok (Esm.Closed.Tables.Val.num (Esm.Closed.Tables.nearest v (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r0) x0))

properties.statement: Q-13: the nearest index is a knot (clamping), minimizes |x − knot|, and is strictly closer than every lower knot (ties go to the lower knot).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (r : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) r → (1 : ℕ) ≤ r.length → ∀ (x : ℝ), Esm.Closed.Tables.nearestIdx r x < r.length ∧ (∀ j < r.length, |x - r.getD (Esm.Closed.Tables.nearestIdx r x) (0 : ℝ)| ≤ |x - r.getD j (0 : ℝ)|) ∧ ∀ j < Esm.Closed.Tables.nearestIdx r x, |x - r.getD (Esm.Closed.Tables.nearestIdx r x) (0 : ℝ)| < |x - r.getD j (0 : ℝ)|

properties.statement: Q-13: the first midpoint ≥ x locates the nearest knot, ties low.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (r : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) r → (1 : ℕ) ≤ r.length → ∀ (x : ℝ), List.findIdx (fun (m : ℝ) => Decidable.decide (x ≤ m)) (Esm.Closed.Tables.midsR r) = Esm.Closed.Tables.nearestIdx r x

properties.statement: §9.5.3's current nearest lowering index(data, searchsorted(x, axis)) returns the value at the nearest knot. REFUTED: axis [0, 10], data [1, 2], x = 1 gives 2, not 1.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (v : List Esm.Closed.Num) (r : List ℝ) (x : ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (a b : ℝ) => a < b) r → 2 ≤ r.length → v.length = r.length → Esm.Closed.Tables.eval [] (fun _ => Esm.Closed.Num.nan) (Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.index [Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.const (Esm.Closed.Tables.ofVec v), Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.fn "interp.searchsorted" [Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.lit (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x), Esm.Closed.Tables.Expr.const (Esm.Closed.Tables.ofVec (r.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin))]]) = Except.ok (Esm.Closed.Tables.Val.num (Esm.Closed.Tables.nearest v (r.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x)))

properties.statement: §9.5.1 requires ≥ 2 values per axis but §9.5.5 has no code for a 1-value axis; the model rejects under a non-spec marker. Needs a ruling.

Q-13 does not say what nearest returns for a NaN query (§9.5.3a's 'a NaN query yields NaN' was written for linear). The model and its lowering return the last knot's value; NaN is the other candidate. Needs a ruling.
